title: cdk-construct-sqs-queue examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-sqs-queue/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — defaults
- standard-with-dlq/ — dlqEnabled:true (divergent: creates DLQ queue)
- fifo/ — fifo:true (divergent: FIFO resource type)
- fifo-with-dlq/ — fifo + DLQ (divergent: both)
- encrypted/ — KMS from bridge fixture

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/sqs-queue-examples.test.ts.
